standouts.head: Reclaimed its 50-day average
standouts.text: It closed back above its 50-day average in the last three sessions.
standouts.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

standouts.head: Momentum holding a bull range
standouts.text: RSI has stayed above 42 on every dip for three months and reached 73: the range momentum holds in an uptrend.
standouts.learn: In uptrends RSI tends to hold 40 on dips and reach 70; in downtrends it fails near 60 and reaches 30.

standouts.head: In a 12-week base
standouts.text: It has moved sideways for 12 weeks in a range 15% deep after a +38% advance.

standouts.head: 1 of the desk's strategy kind buying

against.head: Weekly: a pullback that is not done
against.text: The pullback from the Sep 8 high is not done: it has not reached the 0.5 retracement, it is one straight leg, it is too quick for the advance before it and selling volume is rising. A wave 2 usually unfolds in three waves and reaches the 0.618–0.786 of the Apr 21, 2025–Sep 8 advance (−28% to −37%).
against.learn: A real wave 2 takes three waves and time, on lighter volume. Too shallow, too quick, one straight leg or rising selling says it has further to go.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the Sep 28 high, the 50-day average and the 61.8% retracement of the Sep 11–Sep 17 drop, where 4 levels (3 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing
material.text: Price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.
material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: A higher high and a higher low
material.text: Its last swing high and swing low each topped the one before.
material.learn: Rising swing highs and lows are the steps of an uptrend.

material.head: Next support −1.5% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −1.5% below (0.5 ATR), where 7 levels (5 kinds) meet: the Aug 20 low, the most-traded price of six months and the average price paid since the Sep 11 high.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: Pullback in an uptrend
material.text: Price has dipped toward its 50-day average but holds above the rising 200-day, with the 50-day above the 200-day.
material.learn: A dip inside an uptrend; buyers often return at support.
